description: Expander for MATRIX88 — a mute button per matrix point

params.text: A mute overrides the knob, and any CV from an MX88CV

notes: right-click a mute button to solo that point
goes immediately to the right of the MATRIX88, or of an MX88CV already expanding one
menu: Solo mutes by column — a right-click solo affects only the output mix that point feeds, rather than every output
